Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.

Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Angelic Chorus trigger.

206-2411-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3693-7121-7124.description:
Activate Fire Nation Palace's second ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, giving The Incredible Hulk firebending 4 until end of turn.
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker. Its firebending ability triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Walking Ballista's first ability by paying {4}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.
3693-7121-7124.notes: If desired, you can use the remaining {R} to activate Pyrohemia more times and stack combat phases.

1548-7074.description:
Activate Koh by paying 1 life, causing it to gain Port Razer's triggered and activated abilities.
Deal combat damage using Koh, triggering Koh, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat step 2 each combat phase.

57-1322-4846-5904.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
57-1322-4846-5904.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-3995-6006.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

3755-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Resolve the Phantom Train ability

2034-2348-2882-3819-5220.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two land cards in hand.
Infinite Reflection attached to Cultivator Colossus.
2034-2348-2882-3819-5220.description:
Play any land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield as a copy of Cultivator Colossus due to Nature's Revolt and Infinite Reflection.

Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land, adding {C}{C}.

Resolve the land's trigger from step 3, causing you to put any other land onto the battlefield from your hand, draw a card, and then decline to put another land onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{W}{W}{W}.

Deceiver Exarch and Great Whale enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Resolve the Deceiver Exarch trigger, untapping Livio.
Repeat.
